newsitem.title: USA: LeCroy files for 2 million common shares.
newsitem.headline: LeCroy files for 2 million common shares.

text.p: LeCroy Corp filed Thursday with the Securites and Exchange Commission to sell up to two million common shares.

Of the total amount, 658,838 common shares will be offered by the company and 1,341,162 common shares will be sold by certain stockholders. After the offering, outstanding common will total 6,551,982 shares.
The company plans to repurchase about 350,000 common shares from the LeCroy Corp Employee Stock Ownership Trust (ESOT).
Selling stockholders include Advent International Group, with an offer of 1,254,636 and Walter LeCroy, founder and chairman of the board, with an offer of 103,356 common.

The company granted the underwriters a 30-day over-allotment option to purchase up to 300,000 additional common shares. The offering will be made through Prudential Securities Inc, Cowen & Co and Salomon Brothers.
Net proceeds will be used for repayment of indebtedness, including repayment of indebtedness incurred to fund the repurchase of ESOT shares, the company said.
Proceeds will also be used to fund research and development, for potential acquisitions of complementary businesses and for working capital and other general corporate purposes.
LeCroy, based in Chestnut Ridge, New York, develops, manufactures and sells signal analyzers, principally high-performance digitial oscilloscopes and related products.
